# LoanLens - Copilot Instructions

## Project Overview
LoanLens is a full-stack financial planning application that enables complex, real-time financial calculations to generate personalized loan and credit scenarios for users.

## Tech Stack
- **Frontend**: React, TailwindCSS
- **Backend**: Python with Flask
- **Purpose**: Financial calculations, loan scenarios, credit planning

## Code Style Guidelines

### Frontend (React/TailwindCSS)
- Use functional components with React Hooks
- Follow consistent component structure and naming conventions
- Use TailwindCSS utility classes for styling
- Keep components focused and reusable
- Implement proper prop validation

### Backend (Python/Flask)
- Follow PEP 8 style guide for Python code
- Use type hints where applicable
- Implement proper error handling and validation
- Keep routes organized and RESTful
- Validate all user inputs for security

## Best Practices

### Financial Calculations
- Ensure precision in all financial calculations
- Use appropriate decimal types for monetary values
- Always validate calculation inputs
- Include unit tests for financial logic
- Document complex financial formulas

### Security
- Never expose sensitive financial data
- Implement proper authentication and authorization
- Validate all user inputs on both client and server
- Use secure session management
- Follow OWASP guidelines for web security

### Testing
- Write unit tests for critical business logic
- Test financial calculations thoroughly
- Include integration tests for API endpoints
- Test edge cases and error conditions

### Code Organization
- Keep frontend and backend code well-separated
- Use meaningful file and folder names
- Follow consistent import/export patterns
- Document complex logic with comments
- Keep functions small and focused

## Development Workflow
- Write clean, readable code
- Test changes before committing
- Use descriptive commit messages
- Keep commits focused and atomic
- Review code for security vulnerabilities
